name: Spartan Auto & Heavy Truck Parts
old_description: At Spartan Auto parts, we understand the passion behind every restoration project. Our extensive inventory ensures you have access to the highest quality parts to breathe new life into your vehicle. Whether you're tackling a full restoration or just making essential repairs, our knowledgeable team is here to guide you every step of the way. Let us help you restore your ride to its former glory!
about:
Based in Inman, South Carolina, Spartan Auto & Heavy Truck Parts has served the automotive aftermarket for approximately 20 years. The company operates as a privately held distributor of used and OEM components for passenger vehicles and heavy trucks.

The business maintains an inventory of over 100,000 individual parts, ranging from mechanical components to body panels, and fulfills orders through its own e-commerce site and an eBay storefront. Its knowledgeable staff assists customers with part identification and offers price matching on comparable listings. Orders shipped to the lower 48 states typically arrive within one to five business days.

Customers include professional repair shops, fleet operators, and individual enthusiasts undertaking restoration projects. The catalog covers both routine maintenance items and hard-to-find pieces for older automobiles and commercial trucks, supporting everything from daily driver repairs to full-frame restorations.

The company emphasizes its combination of extensive stock, OEM-quality parts, and responsive service as its primary differentiators, aiming to reduce downtime for shops and keep restoration projects on schedule. Competitive pricing and a willingness to negotiate on larger orders further distinguish its offering.
